title: Browser
description: The Browser a machine runs: one viewer for every knowledge base the machine reaches. It belongs to no knowledge base, so its document is kept in the launcher's state home, in `stack/browser.yaml`, not in a knowledge base's repository.

port.description: The port the Browser is published on, on this machine's loopback: where a person opens it, and the origin the issuer's realm allows its sign-in from.
